meta.title: IPO Milega | Live, upcoming and past Indian IPOs, scored
meta.description: Track live, upcoming and past Indian IPOs. Every prospectus gets a scored breakdown, next to GMP, subscription and your allotment odds.
meta.ogTitle: IPO Milega | Every Indian IPO, scored
meta.ogDescription: Track live, upcoming and past Indian IPOs, with a scored breakdown of every prospectus.

hero.lead: See the GMP, subscription, your allotment odds and a scored prospectus before you bid.

board-tabs.title: Mainboard or SME
board-tabs.body: Switch between regular IPOs and small-company (SME) IPOs.

ipo-name.title: Tap the name for full analysis
ipo-name.body: Underlined names open the detailed report: financials, risks and our score.

demand.title: GMP and demand
demand.body: GMP is the unofficial grey market premium, a rough guide to the listing gain. QIB is big-institution demand. A high QIB on the last day is a strong sign.

odds.title: Your allotment odds
odds.body: "1 in 40" means about 1 out of every 40 applicants gets shares. Tap any box to see the details.

check-allotment.title: Closed IPOs
check-allotment.body: Bidding is over for these. Once allotment is out, tap "Check allotment" to see if you got shares.

nothingOpen.title: No {board} IPOs are open for bidding.
nothingOpen.lead: Nothing is taking bids right now. Read the scored prospectus of an IPO opening next, or check allotment for one that just closed.

upcoming.viewAllQuotaLabel: View all {count} IPOs with a shareholder quota
upcoming.holdOneShare: Hold 1 share for the quota in {name}
upcoming.emptyHint: New issues show up here as soon as their dates are out.

past.title: Recently listed
past.subtitle: What GMP predicted vs what happened
past.emptyHint: Listed IPOs land here with our call next to how they actually did.

methodology.title: How the score is built
methodology.lead: Six automated modules read every RHP/DRHP by the same rules. Five of them score on their own, and the sixth combines those into one verdict.
methodology.qibNoteBefore: From the closing day, institutional (QIB) demand nudges the score by up to
methodology.qibNoteAfter: points: a strong QIB book adds to it, and once bidding has closed, an undersubscribed one takes away. Hover a score to see the adjustment.

modules.title: Financial fundamentals
modules.body: Revenue, profit, margins, debt and key ratios across three fiscal years.

modules.title: Risk factors
modules.body: Every named risk in the prospectus, sorted and weighed, plus any pending litigation.

modules.title: Performance
modules.body: Growth history, management track record and standing against listed peers.

modules.title: Flexibility
modules.body: How adaptable the business is to demand shocks, input costs and new markets.

modules.title: Timing
modules.body: Issue size, market conditions and where this filing sits in the listing calendar.

modules.title: Final synthesis
modules.body: Combines the 5 scores into one overall number, with a plain-English list of what looks good and what worries us.

blog.title: From the blog
blog.emptyHint: Explainers on GMP, allotment and reading a prospectus are on the way.

newsletter.title: Get IPO updates by email
newsletter.lead: New analyses and GMP moves, sent straight to your inbox.
newsletter.subscribed: Subscribed. The next analysis lands in your inbox.
newsletter.failed: We couldn't subscribe you. Please try again.

liveCard.qibEarlyHint: Institutions mostly bid on the closing day, so this is usually near 0x until then
liveCard.oddsLater: Subscription and allotment odds show up once bidding numbers come in.

closedCard.noGmp: No grey market quote for this issue yet.
closedCard.perApplicationHint: GMP gain on the minimum retail application
